unit.label: -ly
unit.mentor_note: Everyone learns -ly as the adverb ending, and then meets manly, saintly, heavenly — adjectives. The suffix means "like", and whether the result is an adverb or an adjective depends on what it was attached to.

members.meaning: like a scholar; careful and learned

predict_options.text: Having the character of the thing named

discovery.understand_note: Attach -ly to a noun and you get an adjective (friend gives friendly); attach it to an adjective and you get an adverb (quick gives quickly). Same suffix, two jobs.

applies.prompt: Knowing -ly means "like", what does a scholarly treatment of a subject mean?
